Not a ship.''"<br />"''When did you get to be such a stickler for naval terminology?''"<br />"''My father was an admiral in the Imperial Irmenu Navy.|[[Kal Skirata]] and Walon Vau|<ref name="TC" />}}
The '''Imperial Irmenu Navy''' was the [[Water/Legends|seagoing]] [[Navy/Legends|military force]] of the [[Imperius]], the [[Priest/Legends|priesthood]] of the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Irmenu]]. It patrolled the world's seas, rescuing sailors in distress, battling [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and preventing conflicts between Irmenu's feudal fiefs from getting out of control. Service in the Imperial Irmenu Navy was a religious obligation for members of Irmenu's noble families, and younger sons of the aristocracy who would not inherit could find honor in its service. [[Boat/Legends|Sail-powered ships]] like caravels and galleons were dominant in the fleet.

The Imperial Irmenu Navy was still active during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Walon Vau]]'s [[Walon Vau's father|father]], the [[Count of Gesl]], served as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the Imperial Irmenu Navy, and Vau in his youth attempted to join before being rebuked by his father.
